scene.ko: 원어민 교사의 첫 공개 수업을 참관한 뒤 좋았던 점을 먼저 말하고, 대답하는 학생이 늘 같다는 점과 수업 속도를 부드럽게 짚어 준다.

lines.en: Thanks for letting me observe your class, Emily. I really enjoyed it.
lines.ko: 에밀리 선생님, 수업 참관하게 해 주셔서 고마워요. 정말 즐거웠어요.
alt: Thank you for inviting me to your class, Emily. I enjoyed it a lot.

lines.en: Thanks for coming. I'd love some feedback, since this was my first open class.
lines.ko: 와 주셔서 고마워요. 제 첫 공개 수업이라 피드백을 꼭 받고 싶어요.

lines.en: First of all, your energy was amazing, and the video clip was a perfect way to start.
lines.ko: 우선 선생님 에너지가 정말 대단했고, 동영상으로 시작한 게 아주 좋았어요.
alt: To start with, you had amazing energy, and the video was a great opening.

lines.en: Thank you. Was there anything that didn't work so well?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 잘 안 된 부분도 있었나요?

lines.en: There's one thing you might want to think about. During the discussion, the same few students answered most of the questions.
lines.ko: 한 가지 생각해 보시면 좋을 게 있어요. 토론할 때 질문 대부분을 늘 같은 몇몇 학생들이 대답했어요.
alt: One thing to consider is that the same few students answered most of the questions during the discussion.

lines.en: Oh... I didn't notice that. I guess I was just happy that someone was answering.
lines.ko: 아... 그건 몰랐어요. 누가 대답해 주는 것만으로도 그냥 기뻤나 봐요.

lines.en: That's completely understandable. It happens to all of us. One idea is to give students thirty seconds to talk with a partner before anyone answers.
lines.ko: 충분히 그럴 수 있어요. 누구나 그래요. 대답하기 전에 짝과 30초 동안 이야기할 시간을 주는 것도 한 방법이에요.
alt: That's totally normal. We've all done it. You could let them talk in pairs for thirty seconds before anyone answers.

lines.en: That's a good idea. The quieter kids might feel more confident that way.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이네요. 그러면 조용한 아이들이 좀 더 자신감을 가질 수 있겠어요.

lines.en: Exactly. Also, the pace felt a little fast at the end. Maybe you could cut one activity so there's time to wrap up.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 그리고 끝부분은 속도가 조금 빨랐던 것 같아요. 활동을 하나 줄이면 마무리할 시간이 생길 거예요.
alt: Right. And the end felt a bit rushed. You could drop one activity to leave time for wrapping up.

lines.en: That makes sense. Thank you for being so honest and kind about it.
lines.ko: 맞는 말씀이에요. 솔직하면서도 따뜻하게 말씀해 주셔서 고마워요.

expressions.en: There's one thing you might want to think about.
expressions.ko: 한 가지 생각해 보시면 좋을 게 있어요.
